protocol.source: Use new English news or scientific abstracts in deterministic digest order with an exact labeled center and unchanged native neighbors for both generators. Exclude prior public writing work hashes and overlapping 12-word phrases against excluded seeds. Use the first 40 eligible works, or all if fewer qualify. For abstracts, verify character tags and native sentence geometry directly because the separately published sentence array does not reproduce the clean text for the shared seeds.
protocol.control: Combine each news rewrite with an archival ordinary revision or same-work human-prose substitution. Also score ordinary-only pairs. Report flags by distinct ordinary work.
protocol.comparison: Use both classifiers after verifying that their weights match the app pins. Measure the exact center alone and its three-sentence context. Retain the existing context decisions. The added rule needs every log-odds change to exceed the previously frozen single-boundary point. Measure existing app scope and the optional sentence-anchored expansion separately.
protocol.decision: For local opt-in on an arm require five added exact locations across three source works and both generators, with at most two additional ordinary works flagged. Keep the earlier signal weight at zero.
